name: knowledgeware
description: Style-driven deliverable suite with a central brand registry. Four skills sharing one brandbook format: slideware (two output formats — .pptx via pptxgenjs, or single-file HTML via Reveal.js; asks which when unclear), knowledgebase (multi-page HTML knowledge bases; explicit invocation only — formerly study-guide), chartware (draw.io architecture diagrams), and brandware (brand/style registry manager — website derivation, logo-asset gathering, local Google Fonts installation). Ships 5 generic styles plus a fictional 'acmecorp' example brand; proprietary brandbooks stay in a user-owned directory (KNOWLEDGEWARE_BRANDS_DIR, survives plugin updates) or a private gitignored overlay. One visual identity, every medium.
